commits.subject: Fix Spotless formatting after messaging attribute renames

diagnoses.analysis: This is the aggregate status gate, not a separate build failure. At the frozen head, .github/workflows/reusable-pr-build.yml:62-89 depends on common and exits 1 when needs.common.result is not success. The common workflow contains the failed Spotless job. Fixing the PR-attributable formatting violations addresses this dependency failure; no workflow change or rerun request is warranted.

The attribute renames shortened expressions but left line wrapping inconsistent with Google Java Format in AbstractReactorKafkaTest.java. Applying the repository formatter fixed the exact logged violation. Running the complete Spotless check exposed the same PR-attributable issue in RocketMqProducerExperimentalAttributeExtractor.java and AbstractRocketMqClientTest.java; both were formatted in the same commit. The final complete root and conventions Spotless checks passed. All three file changes are whitespace-only.
evidence: Execution failed for task ':instrumentation:reactor:reactor-kafka-1.0:testing:spotlessJavaCheck' (registered by plugin 'otel.spotless-conventions').
Run './gradlew spotlessApply' to fix all violations.

report.scope: Structural/Git verification only. No target code or tests are executed.

metadata.body:
<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

Renames messaging attributes for 3.0, adopting [open-telemetry/semantic-conventions#4251](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions/pull/4251) and [open-telemetry/semantic-conventions#4250](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions/pull/4250) and moving the remaining repository-defined experimental attributes into their system namespaces. No compatibility aliases or new flags are introduced.

| Old attribute | New attribute |
| --- | --- |
| `messaging.system` | `messaging.system.name` |
| `messaging.kafka.bootstrap.servers` | `kafka.bootstrap.servers` |
| `messaging.kafka.cluster.id` | `kafka.cluster.id` |
| `messaging.kafka.message.key` | `kafka.message.key` |
| `messaging.kafka.message.tombstone` | `kafka.message.tombstone` |
| `messaging.kafka.offset` | `kafka.offset` |
| `messaging.pulsar.message.type` | `pulsar.message.type` |
| `messaging.rabbitmq.cluster.name` | `rabbitmq.cluster.name` |
| `messaging.rabbitmq.destination.routing_key` | `rabbitmq.destination.routing_key` |
| `messaging.rabbitmq.message.delivery_tag` | `rabbitmq.message.delivery_tag` |
| `messaging.rabbitmq.vhost.name` | `rabbitmq.vhost.name` |
| `messaging.rocketmq.broker_address` | `rocketmq.broker_address` |
| `messaging.rocketmq.message.delivery_timestamp` | `rocketmq.message.delivery_timestamp` |
| `messaging.rocketmq.message.group` | `rocketmq.message.group` |
| `messaging.rocketmq.message.keys` | `rocketmq.message.keys` |
| `messaging.rocketmq.message.tag` | `rocketmq.message.tag` |
| `messaging.rocketmq.message.type` | `rocketmq.message.type` |
| `messaging.rocketmq.namespace` | `rocketmq.namespace` |
| `messaging.rocketmq.queue_id` | `rocketmq.queue_id` |
| `messaging.rocketmq.queue_offset` | `rocketmq.queue_offset` |
| `messaging.rocketmq.send_result` | `rocketmq.send_result` |

| Old system value | New system value |
| --- | --- |
| `aws_sqs` | `aws.sqs` |

Update telemetry queries, dashboards, attribute filters, and metric views to the new keys and SQS value. Existing capture flags and defaults are unchanged.

The existing messaging schema URL is retained for now. #21075 tracks aligning it with a published schema before 3.0.
metadata.title: Adopt messaging attribute renames for 3.0
